runtime.network_policy: HTTPS control-plane only; no network after source download

singleton_lease.restart_behavior: reconnect with a new short-lived session; stale attempts remain fenced

health_restart.readiness: A successful Edge connect plus a running poll/renew loop; no public health endpoint is exposed.
health_restart.liveness: The managed runtime observes process liveness and bounded poll progress; transport failure triggers reconnect.
health_restart.restart: Restart on process failure with platform-bounded backoff; startup recovery removes stale temporary workspaces.
health_restart.shutdown: Stop polling, report or cancel the fenced attempt, and remove the temporary work root.

logging.redaction_policy: Allow only stage, safe error code, opaque resource/attempt IDs, counts and sizes; redact tokens, headers, URLs with credentials, local paths and stack traces.

rollback.operation: revoke processor capabilities and active sessions, pause the new runtime, and point the managed service to the previous immutable image digest
